title: Why the Torah was given to Klal Yisrael
summary: Lessons in derech eretz from how meat is prepared and a cup of wine is drunk, and the bitter beans that turn sweet after seven boilings. Why the Torah was given to Klal Yisrael: they are the boldest of nations, and the Torah channels that strength. Also walking with a stick and being carried on Yom Tov.

key_ideas: Derech eretz: prepare food patiently, and don't drink a cup in one gulp.
Bitter beans turn sweet after seven boilings, and a tzaddik falls seven times and rises.
The Torah was given to Klal Yisrael because they are the boldest of nations, and the Torah channels that strength.
Whether one may walk with a stick on Yom Tov depends on whether he needs it.
